surveyor: human account owner (chucky1102), on site in person
method_zh: 13号线沿线四站+一期徒步(西直门K0—学清路K8),智能手机拍摄;全部照片保留原始 GPS 与时间 EXIF;不拍可识别人脸;未进入任何围挡或铁路用地。
method_en: Four Line-13 stations plus an on-foot Phase-1 walk (Xizhimen K0 to Xueqinglu K8), smartphone photography; original GPS and time EXIF retained on every photo; no identifiable faces; no entry into fenced or railway land.
limitations_zh: 单日单人观察,非专业测绘;记录当日上午状态,施工与开放状态随时间变化;照片为现场观察证据,不构成法定边界、权属或工程结论依据。
limitations_en: Single-day single-person observation, not professional surveying; records that morning only, works and opening states change over time; photos are field-observation evidence, never a basis for legal boundaries, tenure or engineering conclusions.
